name: 268. Separate provider calls price separately and rejected decisions bill once (per-call-billing) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-5518 (PR5 preservation group 4b). Local fixture regression: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream, MCP tool server and pricing source. The turns models make one client request two provider calls of 150k input tokens through a real injected tool: priced as the sum they would cross the fixture's 272k threshold and cost $3.004 instead of $0.304, and turns-tiered proves each turn keeps its own service tier. turns-fail fails the third call, and the error bills the two before it, still as two calls. The decision rows have the provider answer with something the conversion rejects: the error carries the usage, OpenRouter's reported cost, or the emulated turn's cached input, and each attempt of a fallback is charged once. Every row reads its own virtual key's budget and log rows, so governance and logging are proved to agree on the same price. Red before the fix: the sums price at the threshold, and native rejections bill nothing. The turns rows that bill one call on main stay green as positive controls. Run with FEATURE=per-call-billing.
